name: What damage should I look for before I spend money on a foreclosed bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What damage should I look for before I spend money on a foreclosed bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: The biggest red flags are **water intrusion, mold, rotten subflooring, failed caulk, and old plumbing fixtures** that no longer hold pressure or drain properly. If the home sat vacant, also inspect the toilet seal, shutoff valves, ventilation fan, and any drywall near the tub or shower.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for leaks, soft floors, staining, mold smell, loose tile, and plumbing that no longer works correctly. Those signs tell you whether the job is a refresh or a deeper repair project.
